answer: The ringer taps the finished barrel all round, and the ring must sound the same at every stave. Stave elm barrel trimmer iron charter is the ringing: a charter elm barrel trimmers hold after trimming bench inspections. The forge is the first tap, made at the belly; the orchard is the last, made before the barrel is marked, and the opal is the mark itself, chalked on the head. A cheat must tap 97 false barrels and chalk 97 false marks.
